blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos has yet to formally accept an invitation from Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to visit Brazil next year, according to Malacañang. In a message to reporters on Sunday, Palace press officer Claire Castro said Marcos “warmly received” Lula’s invitation, which included a proposal for the Philippine leader to bring a delegation of business leaders from various industries to strengthen economic ties between the two countries. Marcos described the invitation as “the most convincing” he had ever received and directed concerned government officials to study the proposal.
